stem: Which action contributes to the resolution of the play's conflict?

options.label: A
options.text: Robert and Belinda leave Jorge and Maura at the beach.

options.label: B
options.text: Belinda writes an article in the student newspaper.

options.label: C
options.text: Robert and Belinda listen to Jorge and Maura talk.

options.label: D
options.text: Robert gives the newspaper adviser an idea.
